mapper.update:
update orders
cancel_reason=#{cancelReason},
rejection_reason=#{rejectionReason},
cancel_time=#{cancelTime},
pay_status=#{payStatus},
pay_method=#{payMethod},
checkout_time=#{checkoutTime},
status = #{status},
delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(case when o.status=2 then 1 else null end) toBeConfirmed, count(case when o.status=3 then 1 else null end) confirmed, count(case when o.status=4 then 1 else null end) deliveryInProgress from orders o;
